name: node_similarity
author: 39bca602
description: Calculates structural similarity between graph nodes using shared neighborhood overlap and Jaccard similarity. In pairwise mode (when target_node is specified), computes mutual neighbors and exact Jaccard score between two nodes. In ranking mode, returns the top_k most similar nodes sharing neighbors with the query node. Supports both directed and undirected graphs.

graph_id.description: Unique identifier of the graph to analyse.

node.description: Reference node ID. Use lookup_node to find node IDs.

target_node.description: Optional second node ID for pairwise comparison. If omitted, the tool ranks the top_k most similar nodes across the graph.

direction.description: For directed graphs, specifies edge direction to follow: 'undirected' (any connection), 'out' (outgoing), or 'in' (incoming). Defaults to 'undirected'.

top_k.description: Maximum number of top similar nodes to return in ranking mode.
